segment_definitions.label: Orkla Foods (2000-2007 definition)
segment_definitions.scope: Nordic food incl. Bakers (Stabburet, Bakers, Procordia, Abba Seafood, Beauvais, Felix Abba) + Orkla Food Ingredients + Orkla Foods International (CEE; Russia SladCo/Krupskaya from 2005/2006; MTR India from 2007)

segment_definitions.label: Orkla Foods Nordic
segment_definitions.periods: sub-segment 2004Q1-2007Q4 (excl. Baltics); main food segment within Orkla Brands 2008Q1-2012Q4 (incl. Baltics)
segment_definitions.scope: Nordic food incl. Bakers (to 2012Q1), Panda (FI confectionery, 2005-) and Kalev (EE confectionery, 2010-); Baltic food cos only from 2008

segment_definitions.label: Orkla Foods (2013-2014 definition)
segment_definitions.scope: Nordic+Baltic food excl. Panda/Kalev confectionery; Rieber & Son Nordic food from 1 May 2013

segment_definitions.label: Orkla Foods (2015-2022 definition)
segment_definitions.scope: C + Orkla Foods International (MTR India, Vitana CZ, Felix Austria); Hame CZ/SK from 2016Q2; Eastern India from 2021Q2

events.change: Four-monthly (tertial) reporting; Orkla Foods a business area in Branded Consumer Goods
First quarterly report; 2000 quarters given as comparatives; segment profit = operating profit before goodwill amortisation (NGAAP)
Superfish moved from Abba Seafood to Orkla Foods International; OFI also takes Orkla Brands' non-Nordic development
IFRS adopted (2004 restated); segment profit = EBITA (before amortisation and other revenues/expenses); SladCo consolidated in OFI
Orkla Foods reported with sub-segments Orkla Foods Nordic (incl. Bakers), Orkla Food Ingredients, Orkla Foods International

Orkla Foods + Orkla Brands merged into business area 'Orkla Brands' (effective 18 Feb 2008): Orkla Foods Nordic (+Baltic food cos from OFI), Orkla Brands Nordic, Orkla Brands International (former OFI excl. Baltics, incl. Russian confectionery), Orkla Food Ingredients
Orkla Foods Romania moved from Orkla Brands International to Orkla Food Ingredients
Bakers sold (deconsolidated Q1-2012)
New BCG structure: Orkla Foods (Nordic food; Panda/Kalev confectionery to Orkla Confectionery & Snacks), Orkla International (Orkla Brands Russia, Felix Austria, MTR); IAS 19R and IFRS 11 restatement
Rieber & Son consolidated 1 May 2013 (Nordic food to Orkla Foods; Vitana, Delecta, Chaka to Orkla International)
Orkla International wound up (1 Dec 2014): MTR, Vitana, Felix Austria into Orkla Foods; Orkla Brands Russia discontinued; Chaka to OCS
EBITA replaced by EBIT (adj.) (after amortisation of intangibles); 2014 restated (1,495 -> 1,488); 'organic growth' terminology
NP Foods drinks (Gutta) into Orkla Foods Latvija from 1 Oct 2015
Kavli DK (1 Mar 2016), Hame CZ/SK (1 Apr 2016); ESMA APM table organic/FX/structure from Q2-2016
Organic growth row added to business-area tables (2016 comparative)
Underlying EBIT (adj.) growth APM introduced
IFRS 16 (modified retrospective; no restatement of 2018); negligible EBIT effect, EBITDA higher
Orkla Consumer Investments created; Orkla Foods unchanged
Frodinge moved from Orkla Foods Sverige to Orkla Food Ingredients
Eastern Condiments (India, 67.8%) consolidated 1 Apr 2021
Exit Russia (Hame Foods ZAO)
Orkla India carved out; Orkla Foods -> Orkla Foods Europe
Portfolio-company model; OFE scope unchanged; price vs volume/mix, contribution ratio, ROCE; organic growth formally adjusts for material distribution agreements and intra-group transfers
Orkla Foods Europe renamed Orkla Foods (no scope change)
Poltsamaa factory/brands sold; Quaker distribution ended; small Danish distribution agreement to OFI

profit_metric_history.metric: Operating profit before goodwill amortisation (NGAAP; 'EBITA' in 2002-04 reports), before other revenues and expenses
EBITA (adj.) under IFRS: before amortisation of intangibles and other income/expenses; 2011-12 restated for IAS 19R
EBIT (adj.): operating profit before other income and expenses (OIE); 2014 restated
EBIT (adj.) incl. IFRS 16 (no restatement; negligible EBIT effect)

organic_growth_history.definition: excluding acquisitions and divestments and currency translation effects (+ other considerable structural changes from ~2013)
excluding acquired and sold companies and currency translation effects
acquired companies excluded 12 months after transaction date; sold companies excluded pro forma 12 months prior; FX neutralised at prior-year rates

organic_growth_history.term: organic growth row in segment tables

organic_growth_history.definition: EBIT (adj.) change adjusted for M&A and FX
material distribution agreements won/lost and intra-group transfers treated as structure
price = net customer price change at unchanged volume; volume/mix = residual
no explicit adjustment; no hyperinflationary operations in the food segment

pre_2000.summary: Orkla reported four-monthly (tertial) interim results until 2000; first quarterly report Q1 2001 with 2000 quarterly comparatives. Tertial and annual Orkla Foods figures for the 1990s are online via Hugin-hosted reports.
pre_2000.breaks: 1991 Nora merger; 1995 Procordia Food + Abba Seafood from Volvo (revenue ~doubled 1994-96); 1997 Kotlin; 1998 Guseppe; 1999 KaKa
